company.name: ClaimSorted
company.shortDescription: ClaimSorted is a insurtech company that develops an AI-powered claims management platform designed to act as a next-generation TPA.
company.description: ClaimSorted helps insurance companies outsource and streamline their claims operations by combining AI-driven automation with human oversight. It offers customizable First Notice of Loss (FNOL) workflows, fraud detection, compliance checks, structured claims data, and a branded claims portal for policyholders. The company works across lines such as auto, property, warranty, travel, health, and liability. It also offers consulting services in claims management, policy review, risk strategy, and regulatory support.
